content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity), Section 7.7 (p0032).**

- **Issue:** Section 7.7 requires Customer to pay Vendor "as liquidated damages and not as a penalty" 15% of annual Fees *per week* an invoice is unpaid — a Customer-payable LD that is punitive in scale and could exceed remaining contract value, and which cuts across our good-faith dispute right in Section 7.3.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** replaced the LD with simple late-payment interest (lesser of 1%/month or the legal maximum) on *undisputed* invoices after 30 days, plus a confirmation that Customer owes no liquidated damages or penalty.
- **Nothing else to flag:** Section 9.4 lets us terminate for convenience owing only accrued Fees (no early-termination fee, so the 3-month fallback cap isn't needed), and Section 21's mutual cap does not preserve any penalty against us. Service credits running to us remain acceptable.
